research_target: V7 independent historical environmental predictability q × geometry-only route-stage urgency U, never claim geometry U is theoretical recourse r
subject_source: Kölzsch et al 2015 J Anim Ecol DOI 10.1111/1365-2656.12281: published 40 complete spring migrations over 2006–2011, 16 generalized stopover regions, 30-year spring phenology predictability

archive_DOIs.expected_label: Migration timing in barnacle geese (Barents Sea)

frozen_novelty_check.existing_known: Kölzsch et al 2015 establishes phenological predictability and better migration timing; Bauer et al 2020 final-stopover information; Theurich et al 2026 wind departure urgency.
frozen_novelty_check.candidate_novel: Independently estimated historical predictive connectivity interacts with independently defined route geometry U to predict timing error; original V7 requires >=10 distinct transitions with independent q, >=3 route positions, >=30 visits, >=2 flyways, |corr(q,U)|<0.90.
frozen_novelty_check.cannot_promote: First identification of cue use, urgency response or social learning, causal natural fitness value, or theoretical actionability r

comparison_excluded_stork.why_not_primary: Triple coarse conditioned proximity is not direct social cue quality, prior 2024 white stork social learning is saturated, and k=1/2 source opportunity keys cannot estimate behavioral q×r.
comparison_excluded_stork.do_not_interpret: No actual stork social contact anywhere; no biological absence proved; other GPS archives and adjacent bin pairs were not searched
